episodes.synopsis: Wolves are dangerous animals, but when a chieftain comes across a lone wolf, he takes pity on the starving creature and feeds him. What will come of this act of kindness?
episodes.title: The Night the Wolf Cried

episodes.synopsis: It is not always easy to find one’s path in life, a dilemma that Maha currently faces. Perhaps the stars themselves can guide her.
episodes.title: Naash's Daughters

episodes.synopsis: People are more than they appear to be at first glance. Sometimes, a coward is the bravest person of all.
episodes.title: The Nameless Faris

episodes.synopsis: Massud does what the monster wants to protect his baby brother. But just because someone bears a burden doesn’t mean they must bear it alone.
episodes.title: Jared's Legend

episodes.synopsis: There was once a man in Baghdad who owned a particular set of old shoes. Who would have thought his decision to throw them out would cause him so much misfortune?
episodes.title: Tanbouri's Shoes

episodes.synopsis: Rafi may be a wise man, but he is not a compassionate one. When a young man begs to become his apprentice, Rafi grows suspicious once the past comes to light.
episodes.title: Poison and Sweetness

episodes.synopsis: They say that kindness has a way of finding its way back to someone. A single mother struggles to provide for her seven daughters when a chance encounter changes everything.
episodes.title: Throw Those Squashes and Carry Me

episodes.synopsis: Iyas has a righteous heart and will not stand idly by when the villainous Safwan bullies others. However, this will not be the last time the two cross paths.
episodes.title: Iyas the Judge

episodes.synopsis: There were once three siblings who did not get along very well. But what starts as a fight over food may end with the three learning a valuable lesson.
episodes.title: Mulukhiyah Wars

episodes.synopsis: Some say that bravery is the absence of fear. However, two sisters are about to learn that true bravery means taking action despite their fears.
episodes.title: Nafla and Nahla

episodes.synopsis: Once upon a time, there was a mischievous jinni who wreaked havoc on a village. But when he meets his match in a clever old woman, he challenges her to a contest of wits.
episodes.title: The Old Lady and The Jinni

episodes.synopsis: A man once received gifts from a mermaid who sensed that he possessed a good heart. Unfortunately, naivety had also taken root within him.
episodes.title: The Mermaid's Gifts

episodes.synopsis: Folktales are more than just stories; they are life lessons each generation passes down to the next. Just as a grandmother shared this tradition, so too shall her family.
episodes.title: Stories are Our Treasures
